type Lease struct
  Outcome LeaseOutcome
  ID string
  Token string
  ExpiresMs int64
type HoldNotice struct
  Outcome LeaseOutcome
  Program string
  ID string
  Token string
  ExpiresMs int64
type EndpointRefusalDetail struct
  Source EndpointRefusalSource
  Decision EndpointRefusalDecision
  Ask EndpointRefusalAsk
  Action string
  Question string
  Credential string
  RetryAfterMs int64
type EndpointProducerCheck struct
  Kind string
  Copy string
  State EndpointProducerCheckState
  Reason string
  Checked string
type EndpointServiceState struct
  Service string
  Readiness EndpointServiceReadiness
  Reason string
  Guarantees []string
  Capabilities map[string]string
  DefinitionHash string
type EndpointDescription struct
  Outcome EndpointDescriptionOutcome
  Program string
  Version string
  Services []EndpointServiceState
  Refusal *EndpointRefusalDetail
  Reason string
  Checks []EndpointProducerCheck
type EndpointDescriptionResult struct
  Value EndpointDescription
func Encode(v *Lease) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
const TimestampLayout
func FormatTimestamp(at time.Time) string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Lease, error)
func ToJSON(v any) (out []byte, err error)
func FromJSON(data []byte, v any) error
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
const EndpointV2Contract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
func DescribeEndpointWithChecks(frame []byte, program, version string, checks []EndpointProducerCheck, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
func ServeEndpointWithChecks(frame []byte, program, version string, checks []EndpointProducerCheck, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
func ServeEndpointRemote(frame []byte, program, version string, admit func(contract, method, profile string) error, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
func RemoteMethodProfile(service interface{}, contract, method string) string
type Presenter interface
  ReadHoldNotice() (HoldNotice, error)
  AckHoldNotice(token string) (Lease, error)
  Start(token string) (Lease, error)
  Claim(id string) (Lease, error)
  BeginProviderCompletion(token string) (Lease, error)
  Renew(token string) (Lease, error)
  Release(token string, shown bool) (Lease, error)
type PresenterTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type PresenterClient struct
func NewPresenterClient(t PresenterTransport) *PresenterClient
type PresenterDispatcher struct
  Handler Presenter
func (PresenterDispatcher) RemoteMethodProfile(contract, method string) (string, bool)
func (PresenterClient) ReadHoldNotice() (result HoldNotice, err error)
func (PresenterClient) AckHoldNotice(token string) (result Lease, err error)
func (PresenterClient) Start(token string) (result Lease, err error)
func (PresenterClient) Claim(id string) (result Lease, err error)
func (PresenterClient) BeginProviderCompletion(token string) (result Lease, err error)
func (PresenterClient) Renew(token string) (result Lease, err error)
func (PresenterClient) Release(token string, shown bool) (result Lease, err error)
func (PresenterDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (PresenterDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (PresenterDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (PresenterDispatcher) DescribeServiceDefinitionHash() string
func (PresenterDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (PresenterDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
